featured.title: ScoreGen
featured.tagline: Sing a melody, get sheet music.
featured.summary: Capstone project: a desktop app that turns live monophonic audio into sheet music. We wrote the signal-processing engine ourselves — pitch detection, onset detection, rhythm quantisation — then export to MusicXML and PDF.

demo.label: Try the pitch detector at the top of this page

featured.title: perfect-pitch
featured.tagline: Why can some people just name a note?
featured.summary: A research model of how people with absolute pitch identify notes. It tests four hypotheses against human psychophysics: an information-bottleneck autoencoder for the critical-period idea, and a recurrent chroma-ring attractor that turns a smooth frequency into a hard category. Predictions are written down before each training run.

featured.title: The Long Road
featured.summary: Weighty, Sifu-style combat with a branching Slay-the-Spire map. At every campfire the party votes on the route, so the couch gets an argument. Built in Godot 4 with a painterly low-poly look, and the art style is also what keeps 3D split-screen cheap enough to run.
